\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:intro}

Structured traffic classification is usually evaluated at low offered load, e.g. below
30\% of link capacity. Kraus et al. report an F1 of 94.32 on the reference corpus
\citep{kraus2019}, and later work reproduces that number under identical conditions
\citep{kraus2019,ostrom2020}. The reproduction used the corrected split described in
\citep[p.~3]{ostrom2020}.

% The sentence below cites a key that references.bib does not define. That is deliberate:
% citation closure has to notice it.
A follow-up study reports a 12.8\% degradation at saturation \citep{voss2021}.

\subsection{Scope}

We restrict attention to encrypted flows, so the $n$-gram features of \citet{nguyen2022}
do not apply. See Fig. 2 for the measurement setup and
\url{https://example.org/harness} for the release.
